references.label: Cap token contracts: appreciating stcUSD vault shares

applicabilityBasis.summary: stcUSD is an ERC-4626 share whose cUSD-per-share exchange rate accrues vested yield. Its redemption unit is underlying cUSD at variable assets per share, not a fixed amount of monetary value. The payment-stablecoin definition in section 2(22) therefore does not fit this token.

references.label: Cap token contracts: cUSD basket and stcUSD ERC-4626 shares

genius.notes: The payment-stablecoin authorization assessment for the underlying token is not inherited by this variable-value vault share. This scope conclusion does not determine whether other financial-services or securities laws apply.
